summary_en: Feasibility, project management, site supervision and delivery.
summary_fr: Faisabilité, pilotage de projet, suivi de chantier et livraison.

tools.name: Autodesk Construction Cloud
tools.positioning: Construction management anchored to the model — because the drawings came out of Revit in the first place.
tools.description: Autodesk Construction Cloud brings together BIM 360, PlanGrid and Assemble into one platform spanning design collaboration, model coordination, field execution, quality, cost management and closeout, tightly coupled to Autodesk's design tools.
tools.real_estate_use: On a project designed in Revit, the coordination advantage is structural: clash detection runs on the federated model, the field team opens the same model on a tablet, and issues raised on site are pinned to model elements rather than to a PDF coordinate. For an owner it makes the digital twin at handover a by-product rather than a separate exercise.
features: Design collaboration and federated model coordination
Clash detection and issue management pinned to model elements
Field execution with drawings, checklists and punch lists offline
Cost management with budgets, contracts and change orders
Quantity takeoff from models
Handover packages and asset data for operations

use_cases.job: Coordinate design disciplines and resolve clashes before they reach the site
Receive structured asset data at handover instead of a box of PDFs

tools.name: Batappli
tools.positioning: A long-standing French building trades package covering quote, invoice and accounting in one product.
tools.description: Batappli is management software for French construction and trade businesses: quotes and invoices with work libraries, progress billing, purchase and stock, site follow-up, customer records and integrated accounting, available on desktop and cloud.
tools.description_fr: Batappli est un logiciel de gestion pour les entreprises du bâtiment et de l'artisanat françaises : devis et factures avec bibliothèques d'ouvrages, facturation de situation, achats et stocks, suivi de chantier, fichier client et comptabilité intégrée, disponible en version bureau et en cloud.
tools.real_estate_use: Its buyer is the established trade business that wants one supplier for commercial documents and books rather than a modern SaaS plus an accountant's package. The integrated accounting is the differentiator: the invoice posts directly, so the year-end handover to the expert-comptable is a file rather than a reconstruction.
features: Quotes and invoices with trade work libraries
Progress billing and deposit management
Purchase orders, suppliers and stock
Site follow-up and cost tracking
Integrated accounting and ledger
Customer records and payment follow-up

use_cases.job: Keep commercial documents and accounting in one package for the year-end handover
Produce trade quotes from a maintained work and price library

tools.name: Bluebeam Revu
tools.positioning: The PDF tool construction actually standardised on — markup, measurement and takeoff on drawings, together in one session.
tools.description: Bluebeam Revu is a PDF creation, markup and collaboration application built for architecture, engineering and construction: measurement and quantity takeoff tools, customisable markup tool sets, drawing comparison, and Studio sessions where several people annotate the same document live.
tools.real_estate_use: Drawing review remains a PDF workflow on most projects, whatever the model contains. Bluebeam is where an estimator does takeoff, where a design review is marked up by six people at once in a Studio session, and where two revisions of a plan are overlaid to see exactly what moved. It is a daily-use tool rather than a system of record.
features: PDF markup with construction-specific tool sets
Measurement and quantity takeoff from drawings
Drawing comparison and revision overlay
Studio sessions for live multi-party markup
Batch processing and document sets
Markup summary export for issue tracking

use_cases.job: Run a live multi-party design review on a drawing set
Produce a quantity takeoff directly from PDF drawings

tools.name: Buildertrend
tools.positioning: Built for the residential builder and remodeler, where the client is a homeowner who wants to see progress.
tools.description: Buildertrend covers estimating and proposals, scheduling, daily logs, change orders, selections, client communication, invoicing and payments for home builders and remodelers, with a customer portal designed for a homeowner rather than a project team.
tools.real_estate_use: Custom home building and renovation differ from commercial construction in one respect that dominates everything: the client lives with the outcome and changes their mind. The selections module makes each finish choice a documented, priced decision, which is how builders defend a change order six months later without losing the relationship.
features: Estimating, proposals and client-facing selections
Scheduling with subcontractor notifications
Change orders with client approval and pricing
Daily logs, photos and progress updates for homeowners
Invoicing, online payments and lien waiver tracking
Client portal with a documented decision history

use_cases.job: Document every homeowner finish selection and change with an approved price
Keep subcontractor scheduling and client updates in one system

tools.name: Built
tools.positioning: One AI-powered platform to fund, develop, build and manage construction real estate — for lenders, developers and general contractors alike.
tools.description: Built is a cloud platform for construction lending and construction finance administration. Banks, credit unions and private lenders use it to manage construction loan pipelines, underwriting, draw and budget management, disbursement inspections and portfolio reporting; developers, owners and general contractors use companion modules for budgets, capital calls, invoicing, lien waivers and compliance tracking.
tools.real_estate_use: A construction lender juggling dozens of active loans needs to know, on any given day, which draws are pending, which inspections are overdue, and where a budget is drifting — work that used to live across spreadsheets and email threads with the borrower. Built centralizes the draw request, the inspection, the lien waiver and the compliance check for each loan, and its AI Draw Agent pre-processes incoming draw packages so a loan officer reviews an exception rather than re-keying a request.
features: Construction loan origination pipeline management
AI-assisted extraction from information memorandums
Draw and budget management with disbursement inspections
AI Draw Agent for automated draw request processing
Lien waiver and compliance tracking
Portfolio and risk reporting for lenders

use_cases.job: Track draws, inspections and compliance across a portfolio of active construction loans
Manage budgets, capital calls and lien waivers on a construction project financed by a Built-connected lender

tools.name: BulldozAIR
tools.positioning: Site observations pinned to the plan, captured on a tablet and turned into a report before leaving the site.
tools.description: BulldozAIR is a French field collaboration application for construction: annotate plans, create positioned observations with photos, assign them to a company with a deadline, track their resolution, and generate site reports and reserve lists automatically.
tools.description_fr: BulldozAIR est une application française de collaboration terrain pour le BTP : annoter les plans, créer des observations géolocalisées avec photos, les assigner à une entreprise avec une échéance, suivre leur résolution, et générer automatiquement des comptes rendus de chantier et des listes de réserves.
tools.real_estate_use: A site visit produces dozens of observations that traditionally become an evening of report writing and a week of chasing. Pinning each one to a plan coordinate, assigning it on the spot and generating the report before leaving compresses that cycle to the visit itself — and gives each contractor an unambiguous location rather than a paragraph of description.
features: Plan annotation with positioned observations
Photo capture attached to each observation
Assignment to companies with deadlines and status
Automatic site report and reserve list generation
Offline capture with synchronisation
Delivery and handover inspection workflows

use_cases.job: Produce a site visit report with positioned reserves before leaving the site
Run a delivery inspection with unambiguous locations for each reserve

tools.name: Document Crunch
tools.positioning: Read every construction contract clause the way a claims attorney would, before you sign it.
tools.description: Document Crunch is an AI contract-intelligence platform built specifically for commercial construction contracts. Its model, CrunchAI, is trained to recognize construction-specific clauses — flow-down risk, indemnification, change-order and notice provisions — and cites the exact source clause behind each finding, across the pursuit, pre-bid and execution stages of a project.
tools.real_estate_use: A general contractor's project executive is handed a fifty-page subcontract the week before a bid deadline and has neither the time nor, in many firms, in-house counsel to read it clause by clause. Document Crunch's CrunchAI redlines the document against known risk patterns in construction contracts — a flow-down clause that shifts liability, a notice deadline buried in a schedule exhibit — and cites the exact clause behind each flag, so a non-lawyer can triage what actually needs a lawyer's attention.
features: AI contract review trained on construction-specific clauses (CrunchAI)
Auto-redlining and version comparison during pursuit
Spec review before bid day
Real-time contractual risk tracking during construction execution
Clause-level citation for every flagged risk

use_cases.job: Triage a subcontract for risky clauses before a bid deadline, without in-house counsel
Track contractual risk across an active construction project as change orders and notices accumulate

tools.name: Finalcad
tools.positioning: Digital site follow-up designed to be adopted by people who do not want software — foremen and subcontractors.
tools.description: Finalcad provides mobile applications for construction site monitoring: observations and snagging on plans, quality and safety checklists, progress tracking, task assignment and automatic reporting, with a deliberately minimal field interface.
tools.description_fr: Finalcad fournit des applications mobiles pour le suivi de chantier : observations et levée de réserves sur plans, checklists qualité et sécurité, suivi d'avancement, affectation de tâches et reporting automatique, avec une interface terrain volontairement minimale.
tools.real_estate_use: Field adoption is the whole battle: a tool a subcontractor's foreman will not open produces no data, whatever it can do. Finalcad's design choice is to strip the field experience down to capture and assignment, keeping the analysis for the office — which is why it appears on sites where previous attempts at digitalisation failed.
features: Observation and snagging capture on plans
Quality and safety checklists with photo evidence
Task assignment to companies with deadlines
Progress tracking against the schedule
Automatic report generation
Offline field use with synchronisation

use_cases.job: Get subcontractor foremen to actually record and close observations
Track progress and quality across several sites from one dashboard

tools.name: Graneet
tools.positioning: Management software for French construction firms, built around the progress statement rather than the invoice.
tools.description: Graneet is a French SaaS for building and public works companies: quotes and bills of quantities, progress-based billing, purchase and subcontract tracking, site cost monitoring, cash flow forecasting and profitability analysis per site.
tools.description_fr: Graneet est un SaaS français pour les entreprises du bâtiment et des travaux publics : devis et métrés, facturation à l'avancement, suivi des achats et de la sous-traitance, suivi des coûts de chantier, prévision de trésorerie et analyse de rentabilité par chantier.
tools.real_estate_use: Construction firms in France bill by situation de travaux — a periodic statement of work completed — and their margin is decided by the gap between the estimate and the actual site cost. Graneet keeps both in one place, so a site foreman's committed purchases are visible against the quoted budget before the loss is realised at closing.
features: Quotes and bills of quantities with libraries
Progress-based billing and situations de travaux
Purchase orders and subcontract tracking
Site cost monitoring against the quoted budget
Cash flow forecasting and retention tracking
Profitability analysis per site and per client

use_cases.job: Bill by progress statement and see committed cost against the quote in real time
Forecast cash flow across sites including retentions and payment terms

tools.name: Higharc
tools.positioning: Generative home-design software that turns a base plan into buildable construction documents, live estimating and a 3D buyer configurator.
tools.description: Higharc is a cloud homebuilding platform for production and semi-custom builders that combines generative home design, plan configuration and estimating in one connected system. A base plan is design-automated into permit-ready construction documents and photoreal 3D visuals, with material estimates generated directly from the same model rather than redrawn by hand each time an option changes.
tools.real_estate_use: A production homebuilder standardizes a set of house plans and needs every buyer-facing option — elevation, garage orientation, a structural change — to update construction drawings and material estimates automatically, instead of sending each change back to an architect. The design team builds and configures the plan library once in Higharc Studio, then sales and estimating pull consistent, always-current documents and pricing from it for every home sold.
features: Generative plan design and configuration
Automatic generation of permit-ready construction documents
Photoreal 3D visuals for buyer-facing configurators
AI-based estimating and material takeoffs
Centralized plan library across a builder's product line

use_cases.job: Configure a market-proven home plan and get updated construction documents and estimates without re-drawing
Give buyers a 3D, shoppable configurator for options and elevations tied to real pricing

capabilities: Generative plan design from a base home plan
AI-based material takeoff and estimating from plan data

tools.name: Immopad
tools.positioning: Digital property inspections on tablet — état des lieux, delivery snagging and periodic visits in one app.
tools.description: Immopad is a French application for property inspections: entry and exit état des lieux, new-build delivery snagging, periodic visits and works acceptance, captured on tablet or phone with photos, signed on the spot and produced as a report.
tools.description_fr: Immopad est une application française pour les états des lieux : entrée et sortie de location, réserves de livraison de biens neufs, visites périodiques et réception de travaux, saisis sur tablette ou téléphone avec photos, signés sur place et restitués sous forme de rapport.
tools.real_estate_use: The état des lieux is the document a deposit dispute turns on, and a paper one written in ballpoint rarely survives it. Capturing room by room with dated photographs and an on-the-spot signature changes the evidentiary position entirely. The same capture engine is used by developers for delivery snagging, where the list of reserves has the same contentious quality.
features: Entry and exit état des lieux with photo evidence
Comparison between entry and exit condition
New-build delivery snagging and reserve tracking
On-site signature by both parties
Periodic and works acceptance visits
Report generation and archiving

use_cases.job: Produce an état des lieux that survives a deposit dispute
Record and track delivery reserves at handover of a new-build unit

tools.name: Kairnial
tools.positioning: Construction document control and site quality for large French projects, with the traceability an owner needs at handover.
tools.description: Kairnial is a collaborative platform for construction and asset lifecycle: controlled document management with versioning and approval circuits, site quality and snagging, safety and compliance records, BIM model consultation, and structured handover packages.
tools.description_fr: Kairnial est une plateforme collaborative pour la construction et le cycle de vie des actifs : gestion documentaire maîtrisée avec versioning et circuits de validation, qualité de chantier et levée de réserves, registres sécurité et conformité, consultation de maquettes BIM, et dossiers de remise structurés.
tools.real_estate_use: On a large French project the governing risk is documentary: which version of a plan was approved, who validated it, and what evidence exists that a reserve was lifted. Kairnial organises that chain — the visa circuit, the dated observation, the signed lift — so the handover file is defensible and the operator inherits usable data rather than a hard drive.
features: Controlled document management with visa and approval circuits
Site observations, snagging and reserve lifting with evidence
Safety, compliance and access records
BIM model consultation linked to documents
Structured handover and DOE packages
Asset data continuity into operations

use_cases.job: Keep a defensible approval and reserve-lifting record across a large project
Receive a structured handover file that operations can actually use

tools.name: Kel Foncier
tools.positioning: Land prospecting for French developers — which parcels can be built on, how much, and who owns them.
tools.description: Kel Foncier combines cadastral parcels, local urban planning rules, building rights, ownership data, building permits and transactions into a mapping and search tool for property developers and land prospectors.
tools.description_fr: Kel Foncier combine parcelles cadastrales, règles d'urbanisme locales, droits à construire, données de propriété, permis de construire et transactions dans un outil de cartographie et de recherche pour les promoteurs et prospecteurs fonciers.
tools.real_estate_use: A French development starts with a question the PLU answers slowly: on this parcel, what height, what footprint, what constraints. Kel Foncier makes that searchable in reverse — find every parcel in a commune with unused building rights above a threshold, filter out the protected ones, and get the owner. It compresses weeks of town-hall work into a query.
features: Cadastral parcels with local planning rules applied
Residual building rights calculation per parcel
Ownership information and owner typology
Building permit history and pipeline
Transaction and land price references
Prospecting lists, alerts and export

use_cases.job: Find parcels with unused building rights in a target commune and identify the owners
Test the development potential of a site before making an offer

tools.name: LEON
tools.positioning: Feasibility and financial-modeling tool that runs a social-housing developer's operations through underwriting and investment-committee approval.
tools.description: LEON is a French SaaS tool from Scepia used by social-housing developers to model and steer PLUS, PLAI and social/free accession housing operations. It runs financial-ratio simulations to check an operation's profitability, keeps national parameters and regulatory constraints up to date, and runs the investment-committee (comité d'engagement) process end to end — scheduling, document distribution, remote sessions, e-signed minutes and voting.
tools.real_estate_use: A social-housing developer's operations team enters a new PLUS or PLAI project and gets a first financial-ratio result within minutes, checking profitability before committing further work. Ahead of an investment committee, the same team schedules the session and distributes the operation's dossier and simulations through a web portal, and for groups running committees remotely, holds the session online with e-signed minutes and recorded votes.
features: Financial-ratio feasibility simulation
Built-in national/regulatory parameters for social housing
Investment-committee scheduling and document distribution
Remote committee sessions with e-signed minutes
Electronic voting

use_cases.job: Run a financial-ratio feasibility simulation for a new PLUS/PLAI operation before committing further work
Schedule and hold a remote investment committee with e-signed minutes and recorded votes

sources.note: site éditeur — page produit, sans navigation tarifs/connexion (modèle sur devis, normal pour ce segment)

tools.name: LightTable
tools.positioning: AI review of construction drawings and specs that surfaces coordination and constructability issues before a project breaks ground.
tools.description: LightTable is an AI-powered quality-control platform for developers and general contractors. Uploaded drawings, specs and checklists are reviewed to flag coordination and constructability issues across architectural, structural, MEP and civil disciplines, with expert human validation layered on top of the automated findings before an issue reaches a project team.
tools.real_estate_use: A developer or general contractor uploads a full pre-construction drawing set before breaking ground, instead of relying only on a multi-week manual peer review, and gets AI-flagged conflicts — a wall that doesn't align between the architectural and structural sets, a missing dimension — ranked by cost impact, with issue ownership and resolution tracked through to sign-off.
features: AI-based coordination and constructability issue detection
Cross-discipline review across architectural, structural, MEP and civil sets
Cost-impact prioritization of flagged issues
Expert human validation layer on top of AI findings
Issue ownership and resolution tracking (ball-in-court)

use_cases.job: Review a full drawing set for coordination issues before construction starts
Prioritize which design conflicts to fix first by their cost impact

capabilities: AI-based review of construction drawings and specs for coordination and constructability issues

tools.name: Northspyre
tools.positioning: Development cost control for the owner's side of the table, not the contractor's.
tools.description: Northspyre is a project cost management platform for real estate developers: budget tracking, invoice and contract processing with automated data extraction, cash flow forecasting, and anticipated cost reporting across a development pipeline.
tools.real_estate_use: A developer's exposure is the gap between the budget presented to investors and the anticipated final cost. That gap usually surfaces late because invoices and change orders are processed manually. Northspyre extracts the data as documents arrive, so the anticipated cost report updates continuously and a lender draw package is assembled from live data rather than rebuilt each month.
features: Automated data extraction from invoices and contracts
Budget versus anticipated cost tracking per project
Cash flow forecasting across a development pipeline
Lender draw package preparation
Vendor contract and change order tracking
Portfolio-level development reporting

use_cases.job: Keep anticipated final cost current instead of discovering the overrun late
Assemble a lender draw package from live project data

tools.name: Obat
tools.positioning: Quotes and invoices for the French artisan, with the regulatory mentions the trade actually needs.
tools.description: Obat is French SaaS for building trades: quotes with priced work libraries, invoices and progress billing, purchase and margin tracking, site follow-up, and the mandatory mentions required on construction documents including insurance and VAT rate handling.
tools.real_estate_use: A tradesperson's quote is a legal document: reduced VAT rates depend on the works and the age of the property, the décennale insurance reference must appear, and a renovation aid scheme may require specific wording. Obat encodes those rules so the artisan does not discover a defect when a client claims an aid and the paperwork is rejected.
features: Quotes with priced work and material libraries
Regulatory mentions including insurance and VAT rates
Invoices, deposits and progress billing
Purchase, supplier and margin tracking
Site and intervention follow-up
Client follow-up and payment reminders

use_cases.job: Issue quotes with the correct VAT rate and mandatory mentions for renovation work
Receive quotes documented well enough to claim a renovation aid scheme

tools.name: Procore
tools.positioning: The construction record of truth — where the owner, the general contractor and every sub look at the same drawing set.
tools.description: Procore is a construction management platform covering preconstruction, project management, quality and safety, design coordination, and financials. Its commercial model charges the owner or contractor by construction volume and gives unlimited free seats to subcontractors and collaborators.
tools.real_estate_use: On a development, disputes are usually about which version of a document someone was working from. Procore holds the drawings, RFIs, submittals, daily logs, change orders and photos in one place, so the developer's project manager, the architect and the concrete sub all reference the same record. Financial modules then tie change orders to the budget the investor sees.
features: Drawing, RFI and submittal management with version control
Daily logs, photos and site documentation
Change order, budget and commitment tracking
Quality and safety inspections with punch lists
Bid management and preconstruction estimating
Unlimited free collaborator seats for subcontractors

use_cases.job: Keep a development's document, change order and budget history in one auditable place
Receive a complete closeout package with as-builts and warranties at handover

capabilities: Document search and summarisation across project records

tools.name: Salvia Développement
tools.positioning: Software for French property development operations — the bilan promoteur, the VEFA sales ledger and the cost control in one system.
tools.description: Salvia Software publishes solutions for French property developers and social housing operators covering development operation management: feasibility and operation budget, cost and commitment tracking, VEFA reservation and sale follow-up, calls for funds by construction stage, and operation profitability reporting.
tools.real_estate_use: A French development operation has a financial structure no generic tool models: the bilan promoteur, VEFA sales where the buyer pays by construction milestone, and a margin that moves with every signed contract and every works order. Salvia is bought to hold that structure — the operation budget and the sales ledger reconciled against one another.
features: Operation feasibility and bilan promoteur modelling
Cost, commitment and works contract tracking
VEFA reservation and sale follow-up
Calls for funds by construction milestone
Operation and portfolio profitability reporting
Social housing operation specifics

use_cases.job: Keep the operation budget and the VEFA sales ledger reconciled throughout the build
Issue calls for funds to buyers as each construction stage is reached

tools.name: Scoplan
tools.positioning: All-in-one management software for real estate developers selling under VEFA.
tools.description: Scoplan is a French SaaS platform for real estate developers, house-building companies (constructeurs de maisons) and renovators. It runs the VEFA sales-to-handover cycle in one tool: prospect and buyer CRM, an extranet for external sales agents, digital reservation with e-signature, batch fund-call generation, works and warranty (SAV/TMA) tracking, and the buyer's digital carnet d'information du logement.
tools.real_estate_use: A developer's sales team tracks reservations and options as units in a program move from launch to signed VEFA contract, while an outside estate agency acting as a prescriber consults the same program and its brochures through its own extranet login. Once construction starts, the works team logs progress against schedule, generates and batches fund calls to buyers, and issues each buyer's digital carnet du logement at handover. After delivery, the SAV team logs and tracks buyer-reported defects (TMA) against warranty deadlines.
features: Buyer and prospect CRM
External sales-agent extranet
Digital reservation with e-signature
Batch fund-call generation
Works and SAV/TMA tracking
Digital carnet d'information du logement

use_cases.job: Track VEFA reservations, options and fund calls for a residential program from launch to handover
Consult a developer's live program inventory and brochures as an external prescribing agency

tools.name: Sogefi GéoServices
tools.positioning: Fifteen French geolocation APIs — zoning, permits, cadastre, transactions — for the software editors who build on top of them.
tools.description: Sogefi GéoServices is an API platform publishing structured French property and land data: urban planning zoning documents (API URBA), building and demolition permits (API ADS), cadastral parcels, condominium registries, transaction prices and natural-hazard zoning. It sells to software editors, local authorities and private-sector integrators rather than to end consumers.
tools.real_estate_use: A proptech editor adding a parcel-lookup or a permit-tracking feature does not want to become a data-pipeline company: it calls Sogefi's API URBA or API ADS and gets the current zoning or permit history for a given parcel, kept current by Sogefi instead of scraped and maintained in-house. A local authority builds its own planning portal on the same infrastructure without operating GIS servers of its own.
features: Urban planning zoning and PLU documents by parcel (API URBA)
Building, demolition and development permit records (API ADS)
Cadastral parcel and condominium registry data
Property transaction prices (DVF+)
Natural and technological hazard zoning (API RISQUES)
Vector map tiles covering French territory

use_cases.job: Check zoning constraints and permit history on a parcel before committing to a project
Feed parcel-level planning and hazard data into an internal tool without building GIS infrastructure

tools.name: Urbanease
tools.positioning: Land prospecting with the canvassing workflow attached — from the parcel to the owner letter.
tools.description: Urbanease provides French developers, land prospectors and local authorities with a mapping platform combining cadastre, urban planning documents, ownership data and constraints, together with prospecting workflow: parcel qualification, owner contact and canvassing follow-up.
tools.real_estate_use: Finding the parcel is half the job; the other half is a disciplined approach to an owner who was not thinking of selling. Urbanease keeps the qualification and the contact history on the parcel itself, so a prospector returning to a commune two years later knows who was already approached, by whom, and what they said.
features: Cadastral and urban planning mapping with constraints
Parcel qualification and development potential assessment
Owner identification and contact management
Canvassing history and follow-up per parcel
Territory and team assignment
Export and reporting for prospecting campaigns

use_cases.job: Run a disciplined land canvassing campaign with history kept on each parcel
Assess planning constraints and potential on a site before acquisition

tools.name: UrbanSIMUL
tools.positioning: A free, collaborative tool from Cerema to help French local authorities find buildable land without further urban sprawl.
tools.description: UrbanSIMUL is a web application published by Cerema, the French public technical agency for ecological transition and territorial cohesion, that visualizes and simulates land occupation at the parcel scale so local authorities can identify vacant or under-used buildable land as part of "sobriété foncière" (land-use restraint) policy. Access is free after registration.
tools.real_estate_use: A planning officer at a municipality or intercommunality opens UrbanSIMUL to screen a commune for parcels that could absorb new housing without converting more farmland or forest, then exports a shortlist to brief an elected official or a developer being approached for a project. The observatoire mode lets several public actors share the same parcel inventory and canvassing notes over time instead of each rebuilding it from scratch.
features: Parcel-level land occupation visualization and characterization
Buildable land potential assessment
Vacant and under-used parcel prospecting
Urbanization scenario modeling
Shared land and housing observatories
Tabular and cartographic data export

use_cases.job: Screen a commune for buildable parcels before approaching an owner or a local authority
Assess land potential on a site ahead of an acquisition or a public consultation

tools.name: Vertuoza
tools.positioning: End-to-end construction company management — quote, planning, site, hours and invoicing in one chain.
tools.description: Vertuoza is a management platform for construction companies in France and Belgium: estimating, planning, site follow-up, worker time tracking, purchase and stock, invoicing and profitability analysis, with a field app for teams on site.
tools.real_estate_use: The recurring loss in a small construction firm is untracked labour hours. Vertuoza chains the estimate to the planning and the hours actually clocked on site, so the profitability of a job is known while it is running rather than at the year-end accounts — which is the only point at which it can still be corrected.
features: Estimating with work and price libraries
Site planning and team scheduling
Worker time tracking from the field app
Purchase, supplier and stock management
Invoicing including progress billing
Profitability tracking per site against the estimate

use_cases.job: Know a job's real profitability while it is running, not at year end
Schedule teams and track hours from the same system as the estimate
